# Castward

> Fishing trip guides, water guides, gear comparisons, and planning tools.

Castward publishes destination and preparation information. Confirm current rules with the cited fisheries authority.

## Useful pages

- [Castward | Find your water. Go prepared.](https://castward.app/): Explore 796 fishing profiles worldwide, including 507 U.S., Canadian and Mexican trips with state and province navigation and personalized preparation.
- [About Castward](https://castward.app/about/): About Castward for the Castward fishing atlas, local plans and contact service.
- [Fishing trip guides, seasons and packing lists](https://castward.app/guides/): Plan a fishing trip with source-checked destination guides, charter comparisons, seasonal advice and practical packing lists from Castward.
- [Fishing Licenses by State and Country](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/): Fishing licence rules for 191 US states, Canadian provinces and countries: who needs one, visitor prices and official links to buy.
- [Florida visitor fishing license planner](https://castward.app/guides/florida-visitor-fishing-license-planner/): Florida visitors aged 16 or older usually need a fishing license, even for catch and release. A properly licensed saltwater charter or pier can cover that outing. Use this planner to separate those trips from beach, private-boat, and freshwater fishing before you choose your license.
- [Ice Fishing: Find the Fish Beneath Your Feet](https://castward.app/environments/ice-fishing/): Plan a first ice-fishing trip: compare a guide with a rental house, check the route, pack dry layers, and learn a simple panfish setup.
- [Minnesota fish house rental: compare two trips](https://castward.app/guides/minnesota-fish-house-rental-checklist/): Before you rent a Minnesota fish house, confirm the guide time, transport, tackle, bedding, power, and cancellation terms. A heated house does not mean every item is included. Use this two-quote worksheet to record the answers, find missing details, and pack for the actual trip.
- [Florida Keys fishing guide & personalized packing list](https://castward.app/destinations/florida-keys/): From a quiet skiff to a day offshore. Pick the experience, then pack for it.
- [Bozeman & Big Sky fishing guide & personalized packing list](https://castward.app/destinations/bozeman/): A river day, without the guesswork. Get clear on wading, floating and what to bring.
- [Yakutat fishing guide & personalized packing list — Castward](https://castward.app/destinations/yakutat/): Build your river-and-ocean escape around the fishing, not the packing anxiety.
- [Fishing Waters: Rivers, Lakes, Flats, Surf and Ice](https://castward.app/environments/): How rivers, lakes, flats, surf, reefs, ice and open ocean fish, what to bring for each, and real trips to plan.
- [Fishing Lingo by Region: Slams, Nicknames and Local Terms](https://castward.app/fishing-lingo/): A field guide to 157 fishing terms from 27 regions. Find local fish names, slams, and the words you hear on the water.
- [Weather](https://castward.app/tools/weather/): Weather forecasts for your next fishing trip.
- [Tides](https://castward.app/tools/tides/): Tides forecasts for your next fishing trip.
- [Interactive fishing atlas](https://castward.app/atlas/): Explore fishing trips on an interactive world map. Filter by water, environment, species and month, then find your next trip.
- [Best time to fish the Florida Keys: choose by target](https://castward.app/guides/best-time-to-fish-florida-keys/): Choose a Florida Keys fishing season by target and trip type. Compare official seasonal references, weather checks and the rules for your planned water.
- [First offshore fishing charter: a practical checklist](https://castward.app/guides/first-offshore-fishing-charter-checklist/): Prepare for your first offshore charter. Check the boat, crew, time at sea, packing list, license coverage and weather terms before departure.
- [What to bring on a guided fishing trip](https://castward.app/guides/what-to-bring-on-a-guided-fishing-trip/): Pack for a guided fishing trip with a personal day-bag list, method-specific additions and a clear split between your gear and confirmed guide provisions.
- [Inshore vs offshore fishing charter: which fits you?](https://castward.app/guides/inshore-vs-offshore-fishing-charter/): Compare inshore and offshore charters by travel time, exposure, fishing method, comfort and gear. Choose the trip that fits your group and dates.
- [How to choose a fishing guide for your trip](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-choose-a-fishing-guide/): Choose a fishing guide by trip fit, verifiable permissions, instruction, written terms and equipment provision. Compare operators without catch guarantees.
- [Alaska fishing packing list: river, boat and lodge](https://castward.app/guides/alaska-fishing-packing-list/): Pack for an Alaska fishing trip with separate river, boat and lodge lists. Confirm waders, tackle, drying access, baggage and current license rules.
- [Florida Keys fishing packing list: flats or offshore](https://castward.app/guides/florida-keys-fishing-packing-list/): Pack for a Florida Keys fishing trip with separate flats and offshore choices, a personal day bag, confirmed crew provisions and official rule links.
- [First Montana fly-fishing trip: wade, float and pack](https://castward.app/guides/montana-first-fly-fishing-trip/): Plan a first Montana fly-fishing trip with wade and float choices, borrowed-gear questions, official access checks and current waterbody restrictions.
- [Questions to ask a fishing guide before you book](https://castward.app/guides/guided-fishing-trip-questions/): Use a copyable fishing-guide inquiry and a quote comparison checklist. Confirm the target, departure, gear, license coverage and cancellation terms.
- [Fishing gear you already own: check before you buy](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-gear-you-already-own/): Check existing fishing gear for fit, condition and compatibility. Separate owned items from confirmed guide provisions and buy only the missing requirements.
- [One-week fishing trip checklist: plan, pack and return](https://castward.app/guides/one-week-fishing-trip-checklist/): Prepare a week-long fishing trip with a timed checklist, clothing quantities, separate travel and day bags, guide questions and final rule checks.
- [A warmer start. A better base.](https://castward.app/guides/merino-wool-fishing-base-layers/): Choose 200 or 250 gsm merino for your fishing trip. Compare fabric weight, fit, care labels, and layers for a river walk or a cold, still session.
- [Fishing waders: fit, types and winter boot checks](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-waders-buying-guide/): Compare bootfoot and stockingfoot waders for winter fishing, check the fit with socks, and choose the right layers without crowding your boots.
- [Fishing layers: what to wear under waders](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-layering-system-guide/): Wear a base layer, add insulation for the cold, and use a shell for wind or rain. Fit the whole system under your waders before the trip. For a rental ice house, pack for the journey across the ice as well as the time inside the shelter.
- [Fishing gear tiers: what is worth the upgrade?](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-gear-quality-tiers/): Choose fishing gear for the water, method, and fit you need. Start with suitable items you own, then compare the missing pieces. For a first guided trip or ice-house rental, get the supplied equipment list before you spend money on rods, electronics, or a complete new outfit.
- [Your first evening at the vise.](https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-for-beginners/): Learn the tools, sort the materials, and tie a fly you can recognize. Start small. Keep the next one simple.
- [Five flies. A good place to start.](https://castward.app/guides/first-five-flies-to-tie/): From a simple worm to a buoyant caddis: five picture-led lessons that teach the skills you will use at the vise.
- [A better first bench.](https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-kit-buying-guide/): Choose a kit that fits your table, your hands, and the flies you want to tie. Skip the box of materials you will never use.
- [How to tie a Woolly Bugger](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-woolly-bugger/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a Pheasant Tail Nymph](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-pheasant-tail-nymph/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie an Elk Hair Caddis](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-an-elk-hair-caddis/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a Zebra Midge](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-zebra-midge/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a San Juan Worm](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-san-juan-worm/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [Florida Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-florida/): Visitors aged 16 or older need freshwater or saltwater coverage for the species they target. The free shoreline licence is only for Florida residents.
- [Alaska Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-alaska/): Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.
- [California Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-california/): Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species repor
- [Minnesota Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-minnesota/): Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Visiting children under 16 must use a parent's or guardian's licence or obtain a youth licence.
- [Montana Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-montana/): Anglers aged 12 or older need a base fishing licence, Conservation Licence, and AIS prevention pass. The advertised base price does not include both r
